facts.statement: The scientific name of the species is Baharipristis bastetiae.
Baharipristis is an extinct genus of sclerorhynchoid shark that lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: Baharipristis is an extinct genus of sclerorhynchoid from the Late Cretaceous.

facts.statement: The species lived between 100.5 and 93.9 million years ago during the Cenomanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Cenomanian (100.5 to 93.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: Baharipristis belongs to the family Sclerorhynchidae.
Baharipristis is classified within the class Chondrichthyes.
The Bahariya formation where Baharipristis fossils were found also contains remains of at least nine other genera of Sclerorhynchid saw-snouted sharks.
facts.quote: It shares the formation with at least 9 other genera of Sclerorhynchid Saw-snouted sharks.

rejected.statement: The genus was described in 1989 by Werner based on isolated rostral teeth found in the Bahariya formation of Gebel Ghorabi, Egypt.
rejected.quote: It was described from the Cenomanian-aged Bahariya formation of Gebel Ghorabi, Egypt based on distinctive isolated rostral teeth.
